query.title: How SLEEPER, welfare, trespass, 5150 and 647F calls ended, by year
query.method: Calls in pd_calls_for_service_2026_datasd.csv, one row per incident number (the latest entry when the publisher repeats one; where the latest entries share a time but not a disposition, the incident is counted as conflicting and under no outcome), whose call type is exactly SLEEPER, CW, 602, 5150, 647F, counted per calendar year of date_time by disposition code. A code beginning A is an arrest, R a report, K no report required; U is unfounded; X, W, CAN, DUP, V are calls cancelled before a unit was sent or on scene, or duplicate calls, and are counted apart. A code ending HR is a call the Crisis Response Team was involved in and is also counted under its first letter. A blank disposition is counted apart, not as K. Other codes are listed as written. Where a year's file was retrieved more than once, only the latest copy is read.
query.sql:
WITH call_rows AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_f3355b31611af889caa76404"
), incidents AS (
 SELECT *, incident IS NOT NULL AND MIN(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) <> MAX(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) AS conflicted
 FROM call_rows
 QUALIFY incident IS NULL OR ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident ORDER BY called_at DESC NULLS LAST, dispo NULLS LAST) = 1
), typed AS (
 SELECT YEAR(called_at) AS call_year, call_type, dispo, called_at, CASE WHEN conflicted THEN 'conflicting' WHEN dispo IS NULL THEN 'blank' WHEN dispo IN ('X', 'W', 'CAN', 'DUP', 'V') THEN 'cancelled_duplicate' WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'A') THEN 'arrest'
  WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'R') THEN 'report' WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'K') THEN 'no_report' WHEN dispo = 'U' THEN 'unfounded' ELSE 'other' END AS outcome FROM incidents WHERE call_type IN ('SLEEPER', 'CW', '602', '5150', '647F')
)
SELECT call_year, call_type, COUNT(*) AS calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'cancelled_duplicate') AS cancelled_duplicate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'blank') AS blank, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'conflicting') AS conflicting,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'arrest') AS arrest, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'report') AS report, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'no_report') AS no_report,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unfounded') AS unfounded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'other') AS other, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome <> 'conflicting' AND ENDS_WITH(dispo, 'HR')) AS crisis_team,
 STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dispo, '; ') FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'other') AS other_codes, CAST(MAX(called_at) AS VARCHAR) AS last_call
FROM typed
GROUP BY call_year, call_type ORDER BY call_year DESC NULLS LAST, call_type

query.title: SLEEPER calls by day
query.method: SLEEPER calls in pd_calls_for_service_2026_datasd.csv, one row per incident number as above, leaving out the cancelled and duplicate codes X, W, CAN, DUP, V unless the incident's latest entries disagree on the disposition, counted per calendar day of date_time. The days covered are those from the first to the last call of any type in the files, in the years the files hold; a day in them with no SLEEPER call is a count of zero, and a day outside them was not covered.
query.sql:
WITH call_rows AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_f3355b31611af889caa76404"
), incidents AS (
 SELECT *, incident IS NOT NULL AND MIN(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) <> MAX(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) AS conflicted
 FROM call_rows
 QUALIFY incident IS NULL OR ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident ORDER BY called_at DESC NULLS LAST, dispo NULLS LAST) = 1
), counted_days AS (
 SELECT CAST(called_at AS DATE) AS day FROM incidents WHERE call_type = 'SLEEPER' AND (conflicted OR dispo IS NULL OR dispo NOT IN ('X', 'W', 'CAN', 'DUP', 'V'))
), span_days AS (
 SELECT CAST(called_at AS DATE) AS day FROM incidents
), daily AS (SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM counted_days WHERE day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY day)
SELECT YEAR(day) AS year, STRING_AGG(SUBSTR(CAST(day AS VARCHAR), 6) || ':' || CAST(n AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY day) AS days,
 (SELECT CAST(MIN(day) AS VARCHAR) FROM span_days) AS first_day, (SELECT CAST(MAX(day) AS VARCHAR) FROM span_days) AS last_day,
 (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(YEAR(day) AS VARCHAR), ',') FROM span_days WHERE day IS NOT NULL) AS span_years,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counted_days WHERE day IS NULL) AS undated
FROM daily GROUP BY YEAR(day) ORDER BY year

query.title: Where SLEEPER calls were sent, by police beat
query.method: SLEEPER calls in pd_calls_for_service_2026_datasd.csv, one row per incident number as above, leaving out the cancelled and duplicate codes X, W, CAN, DUP, V unless the incident's latest entries disagree on the disposition, counted by the beat of the call's address. The ten beats with most calls are read, with every beat's count packed in one column for the map, the citywide total and the calls with no beat recorded.
query.sql:
WITH call_rows AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("beat" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS beat
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_f3355b31611af889caa76404"
), incidents AS (
 SELECT *, incident IS NOT NULL AND MIN(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) <> MAX(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) AS conflicted
 FROM call_rows
 QUALIFY incident IS NULL OR ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident ORDER BY called_at DESC NULLS LAST, dispo NULLS LAST) = 1
), sleeper AS (
 SELECT beat, called_at FROM incidents WHERE call_type = 'SLEEPER' AND (conflicted OR dispo IS NULL OR dispo NOT IN ('X', 'W', 'CAN', 'DUP', 'V'))
)
, beat_calls AS (
 SELECT beat, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM sleeper WHERE beat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY beat
), sleeper_totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS citywide_calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE beat IS NULL) AS no_beat, MIN(YEAR(called_at)) AS first_year, MAX(YEAR(called_at)) AS last_year FROM sleeper
)
SELECT beat_calls.beat, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS neighborhood, beat_calls.calls, citywide_calls, no_beat, first_year, last_year,
 (SELECT STRING_AGG(beat || '=' || CAST(calls AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY calls DESC, beat) FROM beat_calls) AS all_beats
FROM beat_calls CROSS JOIN sleeper_totals
ORDER BY beat_calls.calls DESC, beat_calls.beat LIMIT 10

query.title: Scope and missing data
query.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.
query.sql: WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_919d363a26f899280671e94c") SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(discovery_period) AS unusable_period_rows, MIN(discovery_period) AS first_period, MAX(discovery_period) AS last_period FROM analysis_scope

query.title: Differences by status
query.method: Count of records per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_919d363a26f899280671e94c"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

query.title: Largest changes over time
query.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_919d363a26f899280671e94c"), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN DATE_DIFF('month', previous_period, discovery_period) <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period

query.title: Reports still open, by service
query.method: Reports with no date_closed value and a status that is not a referral, grouped by service_name. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded. A report counts as open more than a year when its age exceeds 365 days. Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_919d363a26f899280671e94c"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_age_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS open_over_one_year, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved GROUP BY category
), service_groups AS (
 SELECT category, staff_group, COUNT(*) AS group_reports FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND staff_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, staff_group
), service_owner AS (
 SELECT category, FIRST(staff_group ORDER BY group_reports DESC, staff_group) AS staff_group, MAX(group_reports) AS staff_group_reports FROM service_groups GROUP BY category
), service_backlog AS (
 SELECT service_open.*, staff_group, staff_group_reports FROM service_open LEFT JOIN service_owner ON service_owner.category = service_open.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(open_reports) OVER () AS all_open_reports, SUM(open_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_open_over_one_year
FROM service_backlog ORDER BY open_over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, category

query.title: Open reports older in some areas (council_district)
query.method: Median age of open reports per service_name and council_district, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 open reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and either an all-area median of 30 days or more or an area median over 365 days. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("council_district" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_919d363a26f899280671e94c"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_area AS (
 SELECT category, area, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_days, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS over_one_year
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, area
), service_all_areas AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT area) AS areas, MEDIAN(age_days) AS all_median_days
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category
)
SELECT service_area.*, service_all_areas.all_median_days, ROUND(median_days / all_median_days, 2) AS times_all_areas
FROM service_area JOIN service_all_areas ON service_area.category = service_all_areas.category
WHERE open_reports >= 30 AND areas >= 3 AND (all_median_days >= 30 OR median_days > 365) AND median_days >= 1.5 * all_median_days
ORDER BY over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, service_area.category, area

query.title: Slower closure in some areas (council_district)
query.method: Median days to close per service_name and council_district, for reports with a date_closed value that were not referred, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 closed reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and at least seven days slower. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("council_district" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,

query.title: Places reported again and again
query.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days.  SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,

query.title: Scope and missing data
query.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.
query.sql: WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_01ae9a640de2a866f958ac43") SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(discovery_period) AS unusable_period_rows, MIN(discovery_period) AS first_period, MAX(discovery_period) AS last_period FROM analysis_scope

query.title: Differences by status
query.method: Count of records per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_01ae9a640de2a866f958ac43"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

query.title: Largest changes over time
query.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_01ae9a640de2a866f958ac43"), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN DATE_DIFF('month', previous_period, discovery_period) <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period

query.title: Reports still open, by service
query.method: Reports with no date_closed value and a status that is not a referral, grouped by service_name. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded. A report counts as open more than a year when its age exceeds 365 days. Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_01ae9a640de2a866f958ac43"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_age_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS open_over_one_year, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved GROUP BY category
), service_groups AS (
 SELECT category, staff_group, COUNT(*) AS group_reports FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND staff_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, staff_group
), service_owner AS (
 SELECT category, FIRST(staff_group ORDER BY group_reports DESC, staff_group) AS staff_group, MAX(group_reports) AS staff_group_reports FROM service_groups GROUP BY category
), service_backlog AS (
 SELECT service_open.*, staff_group, staff_group_reports FROM service_open LEFT JOIN service_owner ON service_owner.category = service_open.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(open_reports) OVER () AS all_open_reports, SUM(open_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_open_over_one_year
FROM service_backlog ORDER BY open_over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, category

query.title: Places reported again and again
query.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days. The place is the text the publisher recorded; a street name without a number can cover many blocks, and several reports can describe one fault.

 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,

query.title: Scope and missing data
query.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.

query.title: Differences by status
query.method: Count of records per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_25fc7467cb025226fcd414de"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

query.title: Largest changes over time
query.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_25fc7467cb025226fcd414de"), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN DATE_DIFF('month', previous_period, discovery_period) <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period

query.method: Reports with no date_closed value and a status that is not a referral, grouped by service_name. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded. A report counts as open more than a year when its age exceeds 365 days. Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.

WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,

 FROM "analysis_regional_data_25fc7467cb025226fcd414de"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (

), service_groups AS (

), service_owner AS (

), service_backlog AS (
 SELECT service_open.*, staff_group, staff_group_reports FROM service_open LEFT JOIN service_owner ON service_owner.category = service_open.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(open_reports) OVER () AS all_open_reports, SUM(open_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_open_over_one_year
FROM service_backlog ORDER BY open_over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, category

query.title: Places reported again and again
query.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days.  SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,

query.title: Scope and missing data
query.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.
query.sql: WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_b9f1a046a8ee10f1f1b891ca") SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(discovery_period) AS unusable_period_rows, MIN(discovery_period) AS first_period, MAX(discovery_period) AS last_period FROM analysis_scope

query.title: Differences by status
query.method: Count of records per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_b9f1a046a8ee10f1f1b891ca"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

query.title: Largest changes over time
query.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_b9f1a046a8ee10f1f1b891ca"), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN DATE_DIFF('month', previous_period, discovery_period) <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period

query.title: Reports still open, by service
query.method: Reports with no date_closed value and a status that is not a referral, grouped by service_name. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded. A report counts as open more than a year when its age exceeds 365 days. Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_b9f1a046a8ee10f1f1b891ca"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_age_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS open_over_one_year, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved GROUP BY category
), service_groups AS (
 SELECT category, staff_group, COUNT(*) AS group_reports FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND staff_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, staff_group
), service_owner AS (
 SELECT category, FIRST(staff_group ORDER BY group_reports DESC, staff_group) AS staff_group, MAX(group_reports) AS staff_group_reports FROM service_groups GROUP BY category
), service_backlog AS (
 SELECT service_open.*, staff_group, staff_group_reports FROM service_open LEFT JOIN service_owner ON service_owner.category = service_open.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(open_reports) OVER () AS all_open_reports, SUM(open_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_open_over_one_year
FROM service_backlog ORDER BY open_over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, category

query.title: Places reported again and again
query.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days. The place is the text the publisher recorded; a street name without a number can cover many blocks, and several reports can describe one fault.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_b9f1a046a8ee10f1f1b891ca"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL)

query.title: Scope and missing data
query.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.
query.sql: WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_2354b2d21d058c78fae10e57") SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(discovery_period) AS unusable_period_rows, MIN(discovery_period) AS first_period, MAX(discovery_period) AS last_period FROM analysis_scope

query.title: Differences by status
query.method: Count of records per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_2354b2d21d058c78fae10e57"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

query.title: Largest changes over time
query.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_2354b2d21d058c78fae10e57"), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN DATE_DIFF('month', previous_period, discovery_period) <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period

Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.

 FROM "analysis_regional_data_2354b2d21d058c78fae10e57"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_age_days,

), service_groups AS (

query.title: Open reports older in some areas (council_district)
query.method: Median age of open reports per service_name and council_district, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 open reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and either an all-area median of 30 days or more or an area median over 365 days. query.title: Places reported again and again
query.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days. The place is the text the publisher recorded; a street name without a number can cover many blocks, and several reports can describe one fault.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_2354b2d21d058c78fae10e57"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL)

FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND place IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, place

query.title: Scope and missing data
query.method: Full filtered snapshot. Missing and unparseable periods remain in the coverage count but are excluded from time comparisons.
query.sql: WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_c924edc5d3fb68a0e28caa07") SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_rows, COUNT(*) - COUNT(discovery_period) AS unusable_period_rows, MIN(discovery_period) AS first_period, MAX(discovery_period) AS last_period FROM analysis_scope

query.title: Differences by status
query.method: Count of records per group across all selected periods. Record share uses ALL filtered rows as denominator, including missing groups. Missing measurements are shown separately; observed values may be incomplete.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_c924edc5d3fb68a0e28caa07"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

query.title: Largest changes over time
query.method: Adjacent observed periods within the same group. Missing intervening periods and missing measurements suppress differences. A zero baseline suppresses percentage change. Partial period coverage and changing populations require review.
query.sql:
WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST("date_closed" AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_c924edc5d3fb68a0e28caa07"), analysis_periods AS (
 SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, discovery_period, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
 FROM analysis_scope WHERE discovery_period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discovery_group, discovery_period
), analysis_previous AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(discovery_period) OVER w AS previous_period, LAG(observed_value) OVER w AS previous_value,
 LAG(source_rows) OVER w AS previous_rows, LAG(missing_values) OVER w AS previous_missing_values
 FROM analysis_periods WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY group_value ORDER BY discovery_period)
), analysis_changes AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_period IS NULL THEN 'No baseline' WHEN DATE_DIFF('month', previous_period, discovery_period) <> 1 THEN 'Missing intervening periods'
 WHEN missing_values > 0 OR previous_missing_values > 0 THEN 'Incomplete measurements' ELSE 'Adjacent periods with reported values' END AS comparison_status
 FROM analysis_previous
)
SELECT *, CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN observed_value - previous_value END AS change,
 CASE WHEN comparison_status = 'Adjacent periods with reported values' THEN ROUND(100.0 * (observed_value - previous_value) / NULLIF(ABS(previous_value), 0), 2) END AS change_percent
FROM analysis_changes ORDER BY ABS(change) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST, discovery_period

query.title: Open reports older in some areas (council_district)
query.method: Median age of open reports per service_name and council_district, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 open reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and either an all-area median of 30 days or more or an area median over 365 days. query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("council_district" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,

 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, area

query.title: Places reported again and again
query.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days. The place is the text the publisher recorded; a street name without a number can cover many blocks, and several reports can describe one fault.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_c924edc5d3fb68a0e28caa07"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL)
SELECT category, place, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days
FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND place IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, place
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 AND MAX(age_days) > 90 ORDER BY open_reports DESC, category, place

query.title: Reports referred elsewhere
query.method: Reports whose status names a referral, per service_name. A service is listed with at least 100 referred reports making up at least a quarter of its reports. Totals cover every service.

 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,

WITH analysis_scope AS (SELECT "service_request_id" AS "source: service_request_id", "service_request_parent_id" AS "source: service_request_parent_id", "sap_notification_number" AS "source: sap_notification_number", "date_requested" AS "source: date_requested", "case_age_days" AS "source: case_age_days", "case_record_type" AS "source: case_record_type", "service_name" AS "source: service_name", "service_name_detail" AS "source: service_name_detail", "date_closed" AS "source: date_closed", "status" AS "source: status", "lat" AS "source: lat", "lng" AS "source: lng", "street_address" AS "source: street_address", "zipcode" AS "source: zipcode", "council_district" AS "source: council_district", "comm_plan_code" AS "source: comm_plan_code", "comm_plan_name" AS "source: comm_plan_name", "park_name" AS "source: park_name", "case_origin" AS "source: case_origin", "referred" AS "source: referred", "iamfloc" AS "source: iamfloc", "floc" AS "source: floc", "public_description" AS "source: public_description", CAST("status" AS VARCHAR) AS discovery_group, NULL AS discovery_period FROM "analysis_regional_data_a5b003d6955ae6f54d5e20e0"), analysis_groups AS (
  SELECT discovery_group AS group_value, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, 0 AS missing_values, COUNT(*) AS observed_value
  FROM analysis_scope GROUP BY discovery_group
) SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * source_rows / NULLIF(SUM(source_rows) OVER (), 0), 2) AS record_share_percent
FROM analysis_groups ORDER BY ABS(observed_value) DESC NULLS LAST, group_value NULLS LAST

query.title: Reports still open, by service
query.method: Reports with no date_closed value and a status that is not a referral, grouped by service_name. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded. A report counts as open more than a year when its age exceeds 365 days. Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_a5b003d6955ae6f54d5e20e0"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_age_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS open_over_one_year, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved GROUP BY category
), service_groups AS (
 SELECT category, staff_group, COUNT(*) AS group_reports FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND staff_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, staff_group
), service_owner AS (
 SELECT category, FIRST(staff_group ORDER BY group_reports DESC, staff_group) AS staff_group, MAX(group_reports) AS staff_group_reports FROM service_groups GROUP BY category
), service_backlog AS (
 SELECT service_open.*, staff_group, staff_group_reports FROM service_open LEFT JOIN service_owner ON service_owner.category = service_open.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(open_reports) OVER () AS all_open_reports, SUM(open_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_open_over_one_year
FROM service_backlog ORDER BY open_over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, category

query.title: Open reports older in some areas (council_district)
query.method: Median age of open reports per service_name and council_district, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 open reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and either an all-area median of 30 days or more or an area median over 365 days. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("council_district" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,

 FROM "analysis_regional_data_a5b003d6955ae6f54d5e20e0"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_area AS (
 SELECT category, area, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_days, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS over_one_year
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, area
), service_all_areas AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT area) AS areas, MEDIAN(age_days) AS all_median_days
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category
)
SELECT service_area.*, service_all_areas.all_median_days, ROUND(median_days / all_median_days, 2) AS times_all_areas
FROM service_area JOIN service_all_areas ON service_area.category = service_all_areas.category
WHERE open_reports >= 30 AND areas >= 3 AND (all_median_days >= 30 OR median_days > 365) AND median_days >= 1.5 * all_median_days
ORDER BY over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, service_area.category, area

query.title: Places reported again and again
query.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days. The place is the text the publisher recorded; a street name without a number can cover many blocks, and several reports can describe one fault.
query.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,

 FROM "analysis_regional_data_a5b003d6955ae6f54d5e20e0"

leads.title: 340 calls dispatched as SLEEPER in 2026 so far: 5 ended in arrest, 16 with the Crisis Response Team, 303 with no report required
leads.detail: SLEEPER in 2026 so far: 372 calls, 340 calls not cancelled; of the 340 with a disposition, 5 (1.5%) ended in arrest, 16 (4.7%) with the Crisis Response Team, 303 (89.1%) with no report required, 3 (0.9%) with a report, 0 (0.0%) unfounded and 29 (8.5%) with another code (O); 0 have no disposition recorded and 32 were cancelled or duplicates. Cancelled and duplicate calls (X, W, CAN, DUP, V) are left out of the calls counted, and calls with no disposition are not counted as no report required. A code ending HR is counted both under the Crisis Response Team and under its first letter, so the figures overlap. CW (check the welfare) in 2026: 19,831 calls, 17,583 calls not cancelled; of the 17,580 with a disposition, 754 (4.3%) ended in arrest, 491 (2.8%) with the Crisis Response Team, 15,214 (86.5%) with no report required, 517 (2.9%) with a report, 246 (1.4%) unfounded and 849 (4.8%) with another code (O; DEF; MT; SS-; OHR); 3 have no disposition recorded and 2,248 were cancelled or duplicates. 602 (trespassing) in 2026: 4,757 calls, 4,046 calls not cancelled; of the 4,046 with a disposition, 96 (2.4%) ended in arrest, 115 (2.8%) with the Crisis Response Team, 3,602 (89.0%) with no report required, 38 (0.9%) with a report, 78 (1.9%) unfounded and 232 (5.7%) with another code (O; DEF; SS-); 0 have no disposition recorded and 711 were cancelled or duplicates. 5150 (listed as mental case) in 2026: 8,734 calls, 6,022 calls not cancelled; of the 6,021 with a disposition, 572 (9.5%) ended in arrest, 166 (2.8%) with the Crisis Response Team, 4,904 (81.4%) with no report required, 146 (2.4%) with a report, 76 (1.3%) unfounded and 323 (5.4%) with another code (O; DEF; MT; SS-); 1 have no disposition recorded and 2,712 were cancelled or duplicates. 647F (drunk, drugs or alcohol) in 2026: 1,224 calls, 1,077 calls not cancelled; of the 1,076 with a disposition, 63 (5.9%) ended in arrest, 22 (2.0%) with the Crisis Response Team, 937 (87.1%) with no report required, 7 (0.7%) with a report, 16 (1.5%) unfounded and 53 (4.9%) with another code (O; DEF); 1 have no disposition recorded and 147 were cancelled or duplicates. A call type is the dispatcher's label when the call was entered, not a finding that anyone was unhoused. K means no report was required, not that no service was given. The file records no arrival or clear time. The publisher leaves out sensitive call types such as domestic violence and child abuse.
leads.question: What did the officers record on the SLEEPER calls that ended in arrest, and what was each arrest for? The CAD event narratives and arrest reports for these incidents would show it.
leads.method: Calls in pd_calls_for_service_2026_datasd.csv, one row per incident number (the latest entry when the publisher repeats one; where the latest entries share a time but not a disposition, the incident is counted as conflicting and under no outcome), whose call type is exactly SLEEPER, CW, 602, 5150, 647F, counted per calendar year of date_time by disposition code. A code beginning A is an arrest, R a report, K no report required; U is unfounded; X, W, CAN, DUP, V are calls cancelled before a unit was sent or on scene, or duplicate calls, and are counted apart. A code ending HR is a call the Crisis Response Team was involved in and is also counted under its first letter. A blank disposition is counted apart, not as K. Other codes are listed as written. Where a year's file was retrieved more than once, only the latest copy is read.
leads.sql:
WITH call_rows AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_f3355b31611af889caa76404"
), incidents AS (
 SELECT *, incident IS NOT NULL AND MIN(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) <> MAX(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) AS conflicted
 FROM call_rows
 QUALIFY incident IS NULL OR ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident ORDER BY called_at DESC NULLS LAST, dispo NULLS LAST) = 1
), typed AS (
 SELECT YEAR(called_at) AS call_year, call_type, dispo, called_at, CASE WHEN conflicted THEN 'conflicting' WHEN dispo IS NULL THEN 'blank' WHEN dispo IN ('X', 'W', 'CAN', 'DUP', 'V') THEN 'cancelled_duplicate' WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'A') THEN 'arrest'
  WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'R') THEN 'report' WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'K') THEN 'no_report' WHEN dispo = 'U' THEN 'unfounded' ELSE 'other' END AS outcome FROM incidents WHERE call_type IN ('SLEEPER', 'CW', '602', '5150', '647F')
)
SELECT call_year, call_type, COUNT(*) AS calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'cancelled_duplicate') AS cancelled_duplicate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'blank') AS blank, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'conflicting') AS conflicting,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'arrest') AS arrest, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'report') AS report, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'no_report') AS no_report,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unfounded') AS unfounded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'other') AS other, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome <> 'conflicting' AND ENDS_WITH(dispo, 'HR')) AS crisis_team,
 STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dispo, '; ') FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'other') AS other_codes, CAST(MAX(called_at) AS VARCHAR) AS last_call
FROM typed
GROUP BY call_year, call_type ORDER BY call_year DESC NULLS LAST, call_type

The ten beats with most calls are read, with every beat's count packed in one column for the map, the citywide total and the calls with no beat recorded.

 FROM "analysis_regional_data_f3355b31611af889caa76404"
), incidents AS (

 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_c924edc5d3fb68a0e28caa07"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL)
SELECT category, place, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days
FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND place IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, place
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 AND MAX(age_days) > 90 ORDER BY open_reports DESC, category, place

leads.method: Reports whose status names a referral, per service_name. A service is listed with at least 100 referred reports making up at least a quarter of its reports. Totals cover every service.
