WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_c924edc5d3fb68a0e28caa07"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_referrals AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS reports, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE referred) AS referred_reports
 FROM service_reports GROUP BY category
), service_referral_totals AS (
 SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * referred_reports / reports, 1) AS referred_percent,
  SUM(reports) OVER () AS all_reports, SUM(referred_reports) OVER () AS all_referred_reports
 FROM service_referrals
)
SELECT * FROM service_referral_totals WHERE referred_reports > 0 ORDER BY referred_reports DESC, category

The publisher lists Sidewalk Repair Issue (14,645 of 14,690 open reports), Street Light Maintenance (14,332 of 14,358 open reports) and ROW Maintenance (10,471 of 10,564 open reports) under its staff group TSW, read here as the Transportation and Stormwater departments. No operating budget table is imported, so no adopted amount is shown. An open report is not proof the problem persists: the table records no inspections or work done.
leads.question: What do the Transportation and Stormwater budget and staffing say about the Sidewalk Repair Issue backlog?
leads.method: Reports with no date_closed value and a status that is not a referral, grouped by service_name. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded. A report counts as open more than a year when its age exceeds 365 days. Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.
leads.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_regional_data_a5b003d6955ae6f54d5e20e0"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_age_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS open_over_one_year, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved GROUP BY category
), service_groups AS (
 SELECT category, staff_group, COUNT(*) AS group_reports FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND staff_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, staff_group
), service_owner AS (
 SELECT category, FIRST(staff_group ORDER BY group_reports DESC, staff_group) AS staff_group, MAX(group_reports) AS staff_group_reports FROM service_groups GROUP BY category
), service_backlog AS (
 SELECT service_open.*, staff_group, staff_group_reports FROM service_open LEFT JOIN service_owner ON service_owner.category = service_open.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(open_reports) OVER () AS all_open_reports, SUM(open_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_open_over_one_year
FROM service_backlog ORDER BY open_over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, category

WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("council_district" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,

 FROM "analysis_regional_data_a5b003d6955ae6f54d5e20e0"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_area AS (
 SELECT category, area, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_days, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS over_one_year
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, area
), service_all_areas AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT area) AS areas, MEDIAN(age_days) AS all_median_days
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category
)
SELECT service_area.*, service_all_areas.all_median_days, ROUND(median_days / all_median_days, 2) AS times_all_areas
FROM service_area JOIN service_all_areas ON service_area.category = service_all_areas.category
WHERE open_reports >= 30 AND areas >= 3 AND (all_median_days >= 30 OR median_days > 365) AND median_days >= 1.5 * all_median_days
ORDER BY over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, service_area.category, area

leads.method: Median days to close per service_name and comm_plan_name, for reports with a date_closed value that were not referred, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 closed reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and at least seven days slower. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded.
leads.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("comm_plan_name" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,

 FROM "analysis_regional_data_919d363a26f899280671e94c"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_area AS (
 SELECT category, area, COUNT(*) AS closed_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_days, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS over_one_year
 FROM service_reports WHERE resolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, area
), service_all_areas AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT area) AS areas, MEDIAN(age_days) AS all_median_days
 FROM service_reports WHERE resolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category
)
SELECT service_area.*, service_all_areas.all_median_days, ROUND(median_days / all_median_days, 2) AS times_all_areas
FROM service_area JOIN service_all_areas ON service_area.category = service_all_areas.category
